content: Notch homolog 1, also referred to as NOTCH1, is a human gene that encodes a single-pass transmembrane receptor. This receptor is part of the Notch family, which consists of Type 1 transmembrane proteins. Members of this family share specific structural features, including an extracellular domain composed of multiple epidermal growth factor-like (EGF) repeats and an intracellular domain containing various distinct domain types. The Notch family proteins are critical in numerous developmental processes, primarily by regulating cell fate decisions. The Notch signaling pathway is an evolutionarily conserved mechanism of intercellular communication that governs interactions between adjacent cells. In Drosophila, the interaction of Notch with its cell-bound ligands, such as Delta and Serrate, establishes a signaling pathway essential for development. While homologues of these ligands have been identified in humans, the precise nature of their interactions with human Notch proteins, including NOTCH1, remains to be fully elucidated. The NOTCH1 protein undergoes cleavage in the trans-Golgi network and is subsequently presented on the cell surface as a heterodimer. It functions as a receptor for membrane-bound ligands and is implicated in various roles during development. A deficiency in NOTCH1 has been associated with the presence of a bicuspid aortic valve. Additionally, there is evidence suggesting that activated NOTCH1, along with NOTCH3, promotes the differentiation of progenitor cells into astroglial cells. Specifically, when NOTCH1 is activated prenatally, it induces the differentiation of radial glial cells, whereas postnatal activation leads to the differentiation of astrocytes. One study has demonstrated that the Notch-1 signaling cascade is activated by Reelin, although the exact mechanism remains unidentified. Furthermore, Reelin and NOTCH1 are known to cooperate in the development of the dentate gyrus, a region of the hippocampus. NOTCH1 has been shown to interact with several proteins, including: Glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta (GSK3B), Lymphocyte-specific protein tyrosine kinase (Lck), Mastermind-like protein 1 (MAML1), Mothers against decapentaplegic homolog 3 (SMAD3), Nuclear factor kappa-light-chain-enhancer of activated B cells 1 (NFKB1), Nephroblastoma overexpressed protein (NOV), Recombination signal binding protein for immunoglobulin kappa J region (RBPJ), SNW domain-containing protein 1 (SNW1), Ubiquitin C, and Yin Yang 1 (YY1).
